question: Which exact path changes city current production item +0x38 during a natural production-list session, and does its local command case validate the item ID?

scope.boundary: This packet distinguishes the observed command-five city item write from a bounded temporary cost-preview substitution. It classifies only command-five's local owner gate and write, not its submitting producer, UI commitment, general valid-ID rule, unsupported-ID behavior, or final production effects.

dependencies.use: Provides the five-word command record, dispatcher, 0-through-65 type table, and local queue path.
Establishes city +0x38 as the current item read by city update.
The earlier decoded displacement scan excluded indexed stores and prepared the runtime discriminator.
Binds observed IDs 101, 104, and 105 to initialized building identities.

staticCommandCase.recordInput: 0x82CDDF18 through 0x82CDDF24 load record words +0x00 type into r30, +0x04 into r31, +0x08 into r15, and +0x0C into r29. The accepted 0-through-65 dispatch at 0x82CDDFF4 through 0x82CDE010 selects the case-five branch at 0x82CDFFF8.
staticCommandCase.ownerGate: 0x82CDFFFC through 0x82CE0010 form city 0x8314FE28 + 0xBC*r15, read signed owner byte +0x00, compare it with r31, and branch away when unequal.
staticCommandCase.writer: On the owner-matched path, 0x82CE0014 calls 0x82CB3F08 with r3=r15; the following 0x82CE001C forms city +0x38 and 0x82CE0020 stores the low halfword of unchanged record word +0x0C (r29). The helper return is not tested between the call and store.
staticCommandCase.localValidity: The case-five entry-to-store path does not compare r29 with an item-ID minimum, maximum, initialized record count, or definition presence. This is absence of a local check only; producer validation and behavior for unsupported IDs remain unresolved.

previewDistinction.writer: In 0x82CE9490, 0x82CE9DF8 saves city current item and 0x82CE9DFC temporarily stores a candidate building item. It calls BuildingWonderProductionCostLookup at 0x82CE9E00 and another helper at 0x82CE9E18, then 0x82CE9E20 restores the saved item. These two stores are not evidence that the candidate was committed as city production.
previewDistinction.qualification: The later output of the second helper and full list rendering are outside this packet.

runtimeObservation.session: One isolated interactive Title launch exited normally with code zero. The owner reported selecting buildings in sequence, beginning with Barracks and later Library. The default-off temporary write observer was enabled only for this launch. Its eight-event cap was reached; the build passed CTest with 41 passed and one skipped.
runtimeObservation.placement: Observed changed halfword writes to 0x8314FE60 + 0xBC*cityIndex for indices 0 through 63 when the new item was in 100 through 236; each event retained source file and line, city owner, old/new values, r3 through r6, and LR.
runtimeObservation.temporaryEvents: The other six captured changed-value events map to 0x82CE9DFC or 0x82CE9E20 in 0x82CE9490. They include candidate IDs 101, 104, and 105 but do not independently prove a lasting choice.
runtimeObservation.qualification: The session proves that command-five's city item store executed for IDs 101 and 104 during the interaction. It does not prove which item the user finally selected or that either item completed construction.

currentEvidence.method: One approved interactive scratch-Title observer logged at most eight changed city +0x38 halfword writes, then the Title exited normally. Exact generated source lines identified two guest functions; a foreground read-only canonical-project raw-word query corroborated dispatcher inputs, type dispatch, owner gate, command store, and temporary preview/restore stores.

entries.result: Record type and three arguments are loaded and numeric case five selects the city write path.
An owner-matched city receives low halfword of record +0x0C at city +0x38; runtime observed two changed writes at 0x82CE0020.
A candidate item is temporarily written, passed through the cost helper path, and the prior item is restored.

currentEvidence.qualification: The logged source-line-to-guest-store mapping is corroborated by current-image words. The private raw log and temporary executable are not tracked evidence payloads.

guards: Do not call numeric type five the original platform command name without an independent source.
Do not treat the temporary candidate store as a lasting production selection.
Do not infer a global valid-ID rule from the local case-five absence of an ID check.
Do not infer construction or described building effects from the current-item write.
conclusion: An observed numeric command-five path stores its record +0x0C low halfword to the owner-matched city's current production item +0x38 at 0x82CE0020. This local case has no item-ID validity check. A separate helper temporarily substitutes candidate IDs for a cost lookup and restores the prior item. A later packet maps one city-choice producer; the global validity rule, final choice in this observed session, and building effects remain unresolved.
